plain.li: Sat in hot water until my fingers wrinkled. Nothing ached, which hasn't happened since I fell ill.
Warm water does what the medicine can't. I came out of it pink and steaming and able to lift my own arms.
[bath] A hot bath, and then straight to bed. Slept the whole night through for once.
[bath] Someone had left the water hot. I lay in it with my eyes shut and let the weakness soak out of my legs.
[bath,winter] A hot bath with frost on the window, still weak as I am. I could have stayed in it till spring.
[spring] Walked down to the spring with a blanket over my shoulders and sat in it up to my chin. The warmth went right to the bone.
[spring] The water comes up warm out of the ground here. I don't know why, and I don't care. My joints have stopped complaining.
[spring,winter] Snow on the rocks all round the spring, and me sitting in warm water in the middle of it like a lord.
[old] At my age a hot soak does more good than any doctor. Don't tell the doctor.
[impatient] They tell me to rest. A soak is the only kind of resting I can stand.

warm.li: Someone had warmed the water before I asked. I don't know who. I hope they know how much it helped.

blunt.li: Hot water. Felt better. Doing it again tomorrow.

cheerful.li: A hot soak, and I'm a new person! Well, a slightly less wobbly one.

gloomy.li: The warmth is the only thing these days that doesn't hurt. I stayed in it until it went cold.

cold.li: Heat eases the muscles and shortens the recovery. I have started taking it every evening.

plain.li: The healer's spell settled into me like warm milk. By supper I could walk the length of the fields without stopping.
I could feel the magic working in my legs, a slow tingling, like pins and needles in reverse. The weakness is going.
Mended by magic today. I don't understand it, but my body seems to, and it's grateful.
There was a light in the room, and then there wasn't, and I felt days better than I had any right to.
[mage] I've cast that working on others a hundred times. It's a strange thing to feel it from the other side.
[child] The healer did magic on me and it tickled. Now I'm allowed to go outside again.

warm.li: The healer sat with me while the spell took. Kind hands, whatever else they can do.

blunt.li: Magic. Felt it work. Stronger now.

cheerful.li: A spell for a sore body! I've asked the healer if I can have another tomorrow.

gloomy.li: The spell helped. I wish I didn't need it.

cold.li: The working shortened my recovery by a day at least. I'll note the effect.
